messages:
zoe: Quick question 1: My teammate Maya needs to observe a regional caregiver day on 2026-12-29 but we have a mandatory on-call shift that week and a hiring panel scheduled. Shed like to bank the holiday into a floating day in Jan or use the emergency sick pool. Which path is correct?

rahul: Short answer: caregiver regional holidays can be swapped or banked to float with manager approval. The emergency sick pool is only for qualifying medical emergencies and requires committee approval. For caregiving (planned), use a swap/bank.

tayla: Add payroll nuance: if you bank to a floating day across the calendar year, mark "cross_tax_year: yes" so payroll tags it correctly. Also, swaps/banks must be submitted before the year-end blackout cutoff (Dec 23) to be treated as scheduled.

zoe: Manager will approve a bank-to-float. If we bank it, do we need to notify Recruiting for interview coverage?

recruiting: Yes please ping #recruiting with the date and request backup interviewers. We keep a holiday-week backup list but need notice to reassign panels. Also update candidate invites.

rahul: Process in People Portal: HR -> Time-off -> Adjustments. Use type: "bank-to-float" or "one-time swap". Required fields: original_date, new_date (or float), manager_approval (attach email), coverage_plan. Example snippet to paste: 

```
- type: bank-to-float
- original_date: 2026-12-29
- float_date: 2027-01-11
- manager_approval: yes (attach email)
- coverage_plan: "On-call covered by Sam; Recruiting backup: Priya"
- cross_tax_year: yes
```

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Year-end blackout for unscheduled PTO = Dec 24-31 UTC. Bank/swap requests filed & approved before Dec 23 are scheduled; after that escalate to People Ops with coverage plan. Link: https://redwood.example.com/hr/year-end

zoe: If Maya ends up needing the emergency sick pool (sudden caregiver hospitalization), what's the quickest route?

rahul: For genuine emergencies: submit "PTO Donation Request" and mark as "emergency - sick pool" then cc people-ops. The Donations Committee meets twice a month; if urgent, flag it "expedite" and attach medical/verification docs. Note: donated hours are reserved for hardship/medical only.

tayla: Also note accrual/carryover: banking a holiday to float uses the employee's float balance; if they have none, it counts as a carryover exception and payroll must approve manual carryover. Use the Time-off Adjustment form option "bank-to-float - carryover exception" if needed.

zoe: Manager approved bank-to-float and I filed the adjustment (submitted 2765432120). Attached approval and coverage note. Ill ping #recruiting to reassign the panel. Thanks. :pray:

people-ops-bot: Ticket created: HR-5999 (bank-to-float caregiver day). Assigned to Rahul.
